body:
nora: Quick follow-up to yesterday's RFC merge. Ops/eval asked for an explicit minimal telemetry + fallback contract for FP8/INT8/4-bit paths. I sketched a compact set we can reasonably emit at 100% and a sampled set for deep inspection.

raphael: Nice. For 100%: precision_profile_id (GUID), precision_label, model@version, degradation_score (aggregate per request), mean_token_confidence, batching_latency_ms, gpu_mem_pct, and prompt_fp (sha256). Keep names snake_case.

anya: Add kv_cache_hits and worker_queue_ms. Also include tokens_saved_pct and cost_delta_usd so product teams can see tradeoffs.

katie: Per-layer stats are expensive at scale. Proposal: 100% get aggregates (mean_abs_delta, top_k_mismatch_rate). Sampled requests include per_layer_mean_abs and per_layer_max_abs. Always emit sample_rate when per-layer present so analytics can correct for sampling.

raphael: Regarding who toggles precision: control plane owns rollouts and policies. Runtime only performs emergency overrides when control plane unreachable. Runtime overrides must be strictly limited and logged with reason_code and metric_snapshot. We need an FSM snippet for on-call.

nora: Minimal FSM idea: state NORMAL -> on (control_plane_unreachable AND infra_pressure AND quality_safe) -> EMERGENCY_FALLBACK. infra_pressure = (latency > 2xSLO OR gpu_mem_pct > 92). quality_safe = (degradation_score < 0.02). Hysteresis: require 2 consecutive intervals before switching. Revert when control plane returns or quality degrades (escalate).

anya: Important safety: runtime should only fallback to profiles that are strictly less memory-hungry and have known compatibility. Don't invent arbitrary mappings; profiles must declare a compatible_fallback_profile_id.

katie: Agree. Also require immutable profile_id and editable profile_label. No renaming a GUID.

raphael: Canary plan: start at 0.5% traffic with shadow sampling of per-layer arrays for all canary requests. Monitor median degradation_score, top_k_mismatch_rate, and cost_delta_usd. Auto rollback if median degradation_score > 0.045 for 3 consecutive 1-minute windows or top_k_mismatch_rate spikes > 0.03. Promotion above 5% requires human approval.

nora: Add composite gate: gate_score = w1*degradation_score + w2*max(0, -cost_delta_usd_norm) + w3*latency_penalty. We can tune weights per product. Initial weights: w1=0.6, w2=0.3, w3=0.1.

anya: Telemetry retention and privacy: default retention 30d. Enterprise opt-in 90d with compliance review. Never emit raw prompt; only prompt_fp and a boolean prompt_redacted. If a customer enables full prompt logging, require explicit consent + secure storage.

katie: Also require runtime to redact tokens that match a company-wide PII regex before hashing. Document in ops runbook.

quant-bot: Automated note: "RFC follow-up: telemetry fields + hybrid fallback FSM + canary thresholds captured. Action items: @nora publish minimal schema example, @raphael update canary playbook, @anya add fallback_profile_id constraints, @katie update retention + PII runbook." :white_check_mark:

raphael: I'll produce a tiny example schema for the RFC appendix (flat json with only scalars). We should avoid nested arrays in the 100% path.

nora: Example snippet I'll add: {request_id, model, precision_profile_id, precision_label, variant, degradation_score, mean_token_confidence, mean_abs_delta, top_k_mismatch_rate, kv_cache_hits, batching_latency_ms, gpu_mem_pct, tokens_saved_pct, cost_delta_usd, prompt_fp, prompt_redacted, sample_rate}. Keep values typed as numbers/strings.

anya: Final ask from eval: share 4 golden prompt families and an initial mapping from degradation_score thresholds to severity. Eval will drop the examples tomorrow.

katie: Good. Let's convert this to a short RFC appendix and land instrumentation. Thanks all."
